# Vittal Design

> React 19 component library built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and Base UI primitives.
> New components and blocks live in `src-v2/` and are distributed via a shadcn-compatible registry (`@vital-design`).

## Agent Guide

- **Markdown pages**: Every docs page is also Markdown at its URL plus `.md`, as linked below (`/zh-tw/docs/<page>.md` for Traditional Chinese). Examples appear as their full source with registry import paths. `/llms-full.txt` joins every English page into one file.
- **Install via shadcn CLI**: Add `"@vital-design": "https://vittal.design/r/{name}.json"` under `"registries"` in `components.json`, start the loaded global CSS file with `@import 'tailwindcss';` and `@import 'tw-animate-css';`, then run `npx shadcn@latest add --yes @vital-design/<name>`.
- **Source of truth for props & source code**: Fetch `/r/{name}.json` (e.g. `https://vittal.design/r/button.json`) for the exact TypeScript source, exported parts, `data-slot` attributes, CVA variants, and dependencies. Fetch `https://vittal.design/r/registry.json` to list every published item and `icon-*` glyph.
- **Legacy package boundary**: `@fed/vital-design` on npm is the legacy v1 (`src/`) surface. Do not use it for new components.
- **Named exports & exact paths**: All v2 components and icons use named exports. Import from exact file paths — consumer apps: `@/components/ui/<PascalName>` and `@/components/icons/<IconName>`; library repo (`src-v2/`): `@/components/<dir>/<PascalName>` and `@/icons/<IconName>`. Never use barrel imports.
- **Base UI `render` prop (no `asChild`)**: Triggers (`DialogTrigger`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `PopoverTrigger`, `TooltipTrigger`, `SheetTrigger`, `CollapsibleTrigger`) and `LinkButton` take `render={<Element />}` instead of Radix `asChild`.
- **Button, LinkButton, and SplitButton**:
  - Pass icons or `<Spinner />` as children marked with `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"`. There is no `icon` prop.
  - Sizes are `md`, `lg`, `icon-md`, and `icon-lg`.
  - Color is controlled by `theme` (`primary`, `default`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `alarm`, `dangerous`), while `variant` is `default`, `text`, or `ghost` (`text` and `ghost` do not accept `dangerous`; use `alarm`). `variant="ghost"` defaults to `theme="primary"`; pass `theme="default"` for a quiet neutral action.
  - Use `LinkButton` (from `Button.tsx`) for links styled as buttons (`<LinkButton variant="text" render={<Link href="/settings" />}>`). Never use `<Button nativeButton={false} render={<a />}>`, which adds `role="button"`.
  - `SplitButton` has no built-in menu (`open` + `splitOnClick`). For an action with a menu, compose `ButtonGroup` + `Button` + `DropdownMenu` with the trigger rendered as an `icon-md` `Button`.
- **Selection & form callbacks**:
  - Selection split: `Select` = flat single/multi value picker (pass `items={{ label, value }[]}` so the closed trigger renders labels), `Combobox` = searchable value picker, `Autocomplete` = free-form text input with suggestions, `tree-select` block (`Command` + `Popover`) = hierarchical path picker, `Command` = command palette, `DropdownMenu` = action menu (closes on pick).
  - `Checkbox` uses `checked: boolean`, `indeterminate: boolean`, and `onCheckedChange: (checked: boolean) => void` (never pass `'indeterminate'` to `checked`).
  - `PasswordInput` and `SearchBar` pass `(value: string)` to `onChange`; `Input` and `Textarea` pass the DOM change event; `NumberInput` uses `value: number | null` and `onValueChange`.
- **Tokens & styling**: Use Vital Design token utilities (`bg-primary-500`, `text-grayscale-opacity-900`, `border-grayscale-opacity-200`) merged with `cn()`. Target internal parts via `data-slot`.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](/docs/getting-started.md): Vittal Design is a React 19 component library built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install Vittal Design in your React project.
- [Tailwind CSS Setup](/docs/getting-started/tailwind-setup.md): Configure Tailwind CSS 4 to work with Vittal Design components and design tokens.
- [Design Lint](/docs/getting-started/design-lint.md): (`@vital-design/vital-design-lint`) Lint your app against the Vital Design theme with @shadcn/lint and Oxlint.
- [Your First Component](/docs/getting-started/first-component.md): Add your first Vittal Design component to a React app.

## Components

- [Overview](/docs/components.md): Every Vital Design component at a glance. Open a card for its docs, examples, and API.
- [Alert](/docs/components/alert.md): (`@vital-design/alert`) A composable message surface for confirmations, warnings, and contextual notices.
- [Alert Dialog](/docs/components/alert-dialog.md): (`@vital-design/alert-dialog`) A modal confirmation that interrupts the user and needs a response before they continue.
- [Autocomplete](/docs/components/autocomplete.md): (`@vital-design/autocomplete`) Free-form text input with filtered suggestions and optional inline completion.
- [Avatar](/docs/components/avatar.md): (`@vital-design/avatar`) Display a user's profile picture with fallback to initials or a default icon, available in 12 color variants.
- [Badge](/docs/components/badge.md): (`@vital-design/badge`) Small status indicator pill with semantic color variants and number or text content.
- [Breadcrumb](/docs/components/breadcrumb.md): (`@vital-design/breadcrumb`) A trail of links that shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy.
- [Button](/docs/components/button.md): (`@vital-design/button`) Trigger actions with default, text, and ghost variants, multiple themes, and icon support.
- [ButtonGroup](/docs/components/button-group.md): (`@vital-design/button-group`) A composable layout primitive for grouped button controls.
- [Calendar](/docs/components/calendar.md): (`@vital-design/calendar`) Date picker calendar built on react-day-picker. Single, range, and multi-select modes with full classNames and components overrides.
- [Card](/docs/components/card.md): (`@vital-design/card`) Composable card surface with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots.
- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox.md): (`@vital-design/checkbox`) A checkbox input supporting checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states. Built on Base UI for accessibility.
- [Chip](/docs/components/chip.md): (`@vital-design/chip`) A toggleable pill component for filters, tags, and multi-select options.
- [Collapsible](/docs/components/collapsible.md): (`@vital-design/collapsible`) An interactive panel that expands and collapses to reveal additional content.
- [Combobox](/docs/components/combobox.md): (`@vital-design/combobox`) An input picker for searching and selecting one or many options.
- [Command](/docs/components/command.md): (`@vital-design/command`) A composable command palette primitive built on cmdk, with input, list, items, groups, and shortcut display.
- [Dialog](/docs/components/dialog.md): (`@vital-design/dialog`) A modal surface for focused confirmations, decisions, and short forms.
- [DropdownMenu](/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md): (`@vital-design/dropdown-menu`) An action menu where each item fires a callback. Use this when items invoke actions rather than bind to a form value.
- [Editable](/docs/components/editable.md): (`@vital-design/editable`) Inline editable text field with display, input, and textarea parts.
- [Field](/docs/components/field.md): (`@vital-design/field`) Composable form field layout with labels, descriptions, errors, and groups.
- [Icons](/docs/components/icons.md): (`@vital-design/icon-<name>`, `@vital-design/vital-icons`) Built-in SVG icon set used across Vittal Design components.
- [Input](/docs/components/input.md): (`@vital-design/input`, `@vital-design/password-input`, `@vital-design/input-group`) Text input components including Input, PasswordInput, and Textarea.
- [InputGroup](/docs/components/input-group.md): (`@vital-design/input-group`) A composable input shell for prefixes, suffixes, inline text, and actions around an input or textarea.
- [Item](/docs/components/item.md): (`@vital-design/item`) Content rows with media, title, description, and actions.
- [Label](/docs/components/label.md): (`@vital-design/label`) Accessible label text associated with a form control.
- [NumberInput](/docs/components/number-input.md): (`@vital-design/number-input`) A numeric input with stepper buttons, locale-aware formatting, and clamped step interactions.
- [Pagination](/docs/components/pagination.md): (`@vital-design/pagination`) Composable page navigation with page links, first and last controls, and ellipsis.
- [Popover](/docs/components/popover.md): (`@vital-design/popover`) A floating panel anchored to a trigger element, used for tooltips with rich content, profile cards, and contextual overlays.
- [Progress](/docs/components/progress.md): (`@vital-design/progress`) Progress primitives and segmented status indicators.
- [RadioGroup](/docs/components/radio-group.md): (`@vital-design/radio-group`) A single-selection group of radio buttons.
- [Resizable](/docs/components/resizable.md): (`@vital-design/resizable`) Accessible resizable panels backed by react-resizable-panels.
- [Scroll Area](/docs/components/scroll-area.md): (`@vital-design/scroll-area`) Scrollable viewport with optional edge fade.
- [SearchBar](/docs/components/search-bar.md): (`@vital-design/search-bar`) A search input with an icon. Supports instant onChange and explicit onSearch (Enter / icon click).
- [Select](/docs/components/select.md): (`@vital-design/select`) A dropdown for choosing one or many options from a flat list.
- [Separator](/docs/components/separator.md): (`@vital-design/separator`) Horizontal or vertical divider.
- [Sheet](/docs/components/sheet.md): (`@vital-design/sheet`) A side-anchored dialog that slides in from any edge — for navigation, filters, forms, and inspectors.
- [Sidebar](/docs/components/sidebar.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar`) Application sidebar with structure, behavior, and a basic neutral default skin. Product-specific looks live on blocks.
- [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton.md): (`@vital-design/skeleton`) Placeholder blocks for content that is still loading.
- [Slider](/docs/components/slider.md): (`@vital-design/slider`) Select a numeric value or range from a bounded scale.
- [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner.md): (`@vital-design/spinner`) Loading indicator for pending actions and async content.
- [SplitButton](/docs/components/split-button.md): (`@vital-design/split-button`) A split action built from ButtonGroup with a primary action and a separate toggle trigger.
- [Switch](/docs/components/switch.md): (`@vital-design/switch`) A toggle control for boolean on/off settings.
- [Table](/docs/components/table.md): (`@vital-design/table`) Semantic <table> primitives with VD tokens for static tables and custom compositions.
- [Table of Contents](/docs/components/table-of-contents.md): (`@vital-design/table-of-contents`) A compact rail of section ticks that expands into the full list of headings on hover or focus.
- [Tabs](/docs/components/tabs.md): (`@vital-design/tabs`) Switch between related panels with underline or pill tab styles.
- [Tag](/docs/components/tag.md): (`@vital-design/tag`) A label component for categorization, status, and filtering. Supports 12 colors, two variants, and optional remove action.
- [Textarea](/docs/components/textarea.md): (`@vital-design/textarea`) Multi-line text input with consistent border, focus, and disabled states.
- [Time Picker](/docs/components/time-picker.md): (`@vital-design/time-picker`) Three-column time picker (hours, minutes, seconds) with click-to-select and CSS scroll-snap.
- [Toast](/docs/components/toast.md): (`@vital-design/toast`) Status-coloured notifications dispatched imperatively from anywhere in the app.
- [Toolbar](/docs/components/toolbar.md): (`@vital-design/toolbar`) Flex layout primitive with role="toolbar". Lays out actions, separators, and spacers above tables, editors, or panels.
- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip.md): (`@vital-design/tooltip`) A short, transient hint anchored to a trigger element with arrow and side controls.

## Blocks

- [Sidebar / Cloud / Flat](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/flat.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-01`) Base cloud sidebar. Frosted glass skin, flat nav with no submenus, no account footer.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Inline Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/inline-submenus.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-02`) A sidebar with submenus. Cloud product sidebar panel with frosted glass, inline nested nav, primary text states, active edge rail, and a bullet collapse control.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Collapsible Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/collapsible-submenus.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-06`) A sidebar with collapsible inline submenus. Same Cloud frost skin and account footer as Inline Submenus; nested items fold with Collapsible.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Dropdown Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/dropdown-submenus.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-03`) A cloud sidebar that shows submenus as a dropdown-menu. Header Add action, frosted glass skin, no account footer.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Secondary Nav](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/secondary-nav.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-04`) Cloud sidebar with secondary navigation and account footer. Frosted glass skin, flat main nav.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Header Actions](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/header-actions.md): (`@vital-design/sidebar-cloud-05`) Cloud sidebar with a mark-only logo, header search and notifications, and account footer.
- [Data Table](/docs/blocks/data-table.md): (`@vital-design/data-table`) Generic data table with grouping, add rows per group, search, sorting, column resizing and reordering, row selection, and inline and popover cell editing.
- [Table Pagination](/docs/blocks/table-pagination.md): (`@vital-design/table-pagination`) Single-row table footer with page controls, a page jump, and rows per page.
- [Tree Select](/docs/blocks/tree-select.md): (`@vital-design/tree-select`) Searchable hierarchical path picker built from Command and Popover.

## Docs

- [Examples](/docs/examples.md): Full screens built only from Vital Design components and blocks, to show how the pieces fit together.

## Design Tokens

- [Colors](/docs/design-tokens/colors.md): Vittal Design color system — primitive palettes, semantic aliases, and named component tokens.
- [Typography](/docs/design-tokens/typography.md): Font family, type scale, weights, and text style conventions used across Vittal Design.
- [Border Radius](/docs/design-tokens/radius.md): Corner radius tokens shared by inputs, buttons, cards, and dialogs.
- [Effects](/docs/design-tokens/effects.md): Elevation shadows, focus rings, button shadows, and gradient tokens.

## Registry

- [Registry](/docs/registry.md): Install Vittal Design components individually using the shadcn CLI.
- [Registry Manifest](/r/registry.json): Machine-readable JSON catalog of all UI components, blocks, hooks, icons, and theme items.
- [Item JSON Endpoint](/r/button.json): Pattern `/r/{name}.json` returning exact TypeScript source, prop types, variants, and `registryDependencies` for any item.
- [Base Bundle](/r/vital-design-base.json): (`@vital-design/vital-design-base`) One-command setup installing `vital-theme`, `utils`, and `vital-icons`.
- [Theme Tokens](/r/vital-theme.json): (`@vital-design/vital-theme`) CSS variables and Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens.
- [Design Lint Policy](/r/vital-design-lint.json): (`@vital-design/vital-design-lint`) Oxlint + `@shadcn/lint` policy enforcing Vital Design theme tokens.
- [Hooks — useDebounceValue](/r/use-debounce-value.json): (`@vital-design/use-debounce-value`) Debounce value hook with configurable delay.
- [Hooks — useIsMobile](/r/use-is-mobile.json): (`@vital-design/use-is-mobile`) Viewport mobile breakpoint (768px) hook.
